items.title: Dr Govinda KC refuses to end hunger strike despite government appeal
items.desc: The government says most of KC’s six demands are being addressed, but the medical education reform campaigner accuses it of going back on a July agreement and insists his protest will continue.

items.title: How Inam Sapkota tested the state
items.desc: The arrest of a previously obscure man has exposed a web of connections involving the Prime Minister’s Office, senior security officials and Supreme Court judges, raising questions about institutional safeguards and judicial accountability.

items.title: Deuba faction steps up parallel convention drive, urges Congress cadres to join
items.desc: The faction says it has completed conventions in 618 local levels and 26 districts, with plans for provincial gatherings on November 20 and a central convention on December 7-9.

items.title: Jhapa’s roadside singer Jetha Murmu, 39, dies
items.desc: For years, his voice rose above the traffic on the East-West Highway. The visually impaired Santhal singer, honoured but never lifted out of poverty, died Friday in Itahari.

items.title: Nepal’s remaining Bhutanese refugees seek legal recognition
items.desc: Three decades after fleeing Bhutan, refugees languishing in Jhapa and Morang remain unable to access jobs, banking, and professional opportunities, while repatriation and family reunification remain unresolved.

items.title: Lumbini cruise to eight-wicket win as Pokhara suffer third defeat
items.desc: Lumbini chase down a target of 98 with 50 balls to spare to move to the top of the Nepal Premier League table with five points from three matches.

items.title: Nepal has two decades to turn its youth bulge into an economic dividend, World Bank reports
items.desc: Weak job growth, remittance dependency, and poor social safety nets threaten Nepal’s chance to capitalise on its demographic dividend.

items.title: Lumbini bowlers restrict struggling Pokhara to 97 for nine
items.desc: Ruben Trumpelmann takes three wickets as Pokhara suffer another batting collapse in their third match of the Nepal Premier League, leaving Lumbini a target of 98.

items.title: Three years after Jajarkot earthquake, survivors still wait for safer homes
items.desc: Delays in identifying beneficiaries, assessing damage and approving reconstruction grants have left thousands of families in temporary shelters, with rebuilding barely underway.

items.title: Kremlin confirms trilateral Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi next week
items.desc: US envoy Steve Witkoff said on Monday that the United ​States would bring together ​delegations from Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi next week to discuss ​post-war security agreements ​and de-escalation.

items.title: Iran-US deal still out of reach despite heightened diplomatic efforts
items.desc: Iran’s Parliament ​Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf said on Tuesday that the ball was in the US’ court after Tehran gave a “strong and rational response” ​to Washington.

items.title: Russell stars with bat and ball as Biratnagar edge Janakpur
items.desc: Andre Russell’s unbeaten 52 and four wickets, including two in the final over, help Biratnagar defend 174 and secure a two-run victory in Kirtipur.

items.title: Russell’s late assault takes Biratnagar to 174 against Janakpur
items.desc: Andre Russell smashed an unbeaten 52 off 29 balls after half-centuries from Lokesh Bam and Imran Sheikh to give Biratnagar a competitive total in Kirtipur.

items.title: Madhav Nepal, Minendra Rijal among 97 accused in Rs735m land-swap case
items.desc: The CIAA alleges that government officials colluded to let a company exchange valuable land in Biratnagar, which should have been confiscated, for cheaper plots.

items.title: Two of eight inmates who escaped Dolpa prison arrested in Rukum West
items.desc: Police arrested the two men during a vehicle check in Aathbiskot Municipality on Tuesday morning. Six others remain at large.

items.title: How Deepak Bhatta became Nepal’s most influential power broker
items.desc: For two decades, Bhatta cultivated extraordinary access to Nepal’s political and bureaucratic elite while keeping himself largely out of public view. A money-laundering investigation has now exposed the networks around him.

items.title: Indian national killed, New Zealander injured in mid-air chopper collision near Everest
items.desc: In what is believed to be Nepal’s first mid-air helicopter collision, two choppers struck each other while attempting to land at Pheriche, raising fresh concerns over flight safety and the growing number of helicopter operations in the Everest region.

items.title: Janakpur and Lumbini eye top spot in NPL double-header
items.desc: Janakpur face Biratnagar in the first match before Lumbini take on Pokhara, who are yet to win a game. The fixtures will also mark the final NPL appearances of Moeen Ali and Andre Russell.

items.title: Six reasons Democrats may fall short of a midterm landslide
items.desc: A shrinking number of competitive races, uncertain Senate contests, turnout challenges and a Republican fundraising edge could limit Democratic gains despite widespread voter dissatisfaction with Donald Trump.

items.title: Kathmandu metropolis bans sale of plastic flowers and garlands ahead of Tihar
items.desc: The move aims to protect local flower growers and ensure that sales are concentrated at designated locations across the capital.

items.title: Protect Nepalis in Saudi Arabia
items.desc: Houthi drones have killed a Nepali worker. Diplomacy must protect the rest and bring the stranded home.

items.title: Nepal and India agree to step up cooperation on border security
items.desc: The two security forces will share intelligence and coordinate efforts to curb smuggling, human trafficking, counterfeit currency and drug trafficking.

items.title: Indian tourist killed as two helicopters collide in Solukhumbu
items.desc: New Zealand citizen of Indian origin and both pilots were also injured in the collision at Pheriche.

items.title: Bhotekoshi floods leave older survivors grappling with loss, uncertainty and trauma
items.desc: Two months on, many elderly survivors remain displaced, haunted by memories of the disaster and waiting for news of missing family members. Authorities are yet to establish how many older people were affected.

items.title: ‘Big Show’ Maxwell announces international retirement
items.desc: Maxwell bows out after 14 years, having helped Australia win two ODI World Cups and a T20 World Cup, but misses out on a farewell match at the MCG.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu begins making landfall on India’s eastern coast
items.desc: Authorities have evacuated thousands of residents, with around 30,000 people expected to be moved to safety in Andhra Pradesh, as the storm follows another cyclone that killed at least six people last week.
